node.text: Markdown to an interactive A2UI experience

BXP-001 · Search the web and use reliable sources. Find Bengaluru's weather forecast for the next three days. Show the date, high and low temperature in Celsius, and rain probability in a table, followed by two planning tips. Return only the answer in Markdown with source citations. Keep the complete answer within approximately 100-500 tokens; aim for 150-220 words including headings and citations. Avoid a generic introduction and follow-up offers. If requested current data is unavailable, say so briefly.

<a2ui> root=Column([a,c,d,e,f],"md") a=Column([b],"md") b=Table(columns=["date","high","low","rain"],rows=[["Wed, Sep 9","31","20","57%"],["Thu, Sep 10","30","211","55%"],["Fri, Sep 1","30","21","55%"]],title="Forecast data",domain="generic",preferredPresentation="cards") c=Text("AccuWeather’s Bengaluru forecast shows cloudy or sunny-interval conditions through the next three days with the highest rain chance on Wednesday and continued shower/thunder/storm potential on Thursday and Friday.","body") d=Text("Carry an umbrella or light rain jacket, especially for afternoon and evening plans.","body") e=Text("Plan outdoor activities earlier in the day, when conditions are likely to stay drier and slightly cooler.","3") f=Card([g],"Additional recovered text") g=List(items=["Date","High (°C)","Low (°C)","probability"]) </a2ui>
